topic: Round 2, building on round 1 (archived at specs/sk-code/code-surfaces/001-surface-consistency-research/research_archive/20261019T081751Z; read its research.md first, especially §7 target layout, §8 gaps, §9 migration). Three questions: (Q1) Doctor alignment: what /doctor:sk-code (.skilled/commands/doctor/sk-code.md, assets/doctor-sk-code-setup.yaml, scripts/sk-code-setup-check.cjs and its legs, parent-skill-check.cjs) checks today, and what legs or checks should be added so the doctor enforces the shared surface contract from round 1 (section order, workflow-link trio, assets/checklists home, no flat topical references, version/changelog match, no surface graph-metadata.json) — name exact files, functions and new leg ids, and how each fails with a repair command. (Q2) A hub-level base architecture for creating a new sk-code mode/surface: what a new surface must touch today (mode-registry.json, hub-router.json, ROUTER.md, hub SKILL.md RESOURCE_MAP union, leaf-manifest.json, compiled route, shared/references/stack-detection.md and phase-detection.md, the advisor plugin surface detection in .opencode/plugins/system-skill-advisor.js, verify-router-sync.cjs which hard-codes SURFACES at line 33, parent-skill-check, playbooks, hermes mirror), and design a scaffold under the sk-code hub (e.g. shared/assets/surface-scaffold/ or similar) with template SKILL.md/README/references tree/§2b smart-routing block, plus a checklist or script that registers the new surface in every place; compare with the sk-doc create-skill canon (.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/assets/parent-skill/scaffold/hub-skill-scaffold.md, packet-skill-scaffold.md) and say whether the scaffold belongs in sk-code or should extend sk-create-skill. (Q3) Routing optimization: remove hard-coded surface lists (verify-router-sync.cjs SURFACES, the skilled/webflow union comments, any other) in favour of deriving surfaces from mode-registry.json packetKind: surface; check how intent signals, DEFAULT_RESOURCE and load tiers differ across the three §2b blocks and recommend one shape; check compiled-route and advisor surface-hint behaviour for all three surfaces. Deliver per question: findings with path:line evidence, a recommendation, and ordered remediation steps with the check that guards each, ready to be appended as steps 8+ to round 1's 7-step plan. Make research.md self-contained: summarize round 1 briefly and cite its archived path.
